2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Dallas’ rebuilt defense gets an immediate test from Jaxson Dart’s new Giants offense
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: Dallas opens with a heavily reworked defense after last season’s collapse, while New York begins the John Harbaugh era with Jaxson Dart making his first Week 1 start. Malik Nabers is questionable with a knee issue, which could narrow the Giants’ explosive options if he is limited. The Cowboys should try to make Dart hold the ball and process changing looks, while New York’s front has to keep Dallas from controlling the night with its passing game and a favorable early-down rushing matchup.
2026_01_DAL_NYG.model_rationale: Dallas has more established offensive answers, but the game can tighten if New York’s front disrupts timing and Dart avoids the turnover-worthy mistakes that often decide divisional openers.
